requests.prompt: Flat, straight-on screenshot of a desktop application window, 16:10, high-fidelity product UI concept. Not a marketing page, no perspective, no device frame, no photo. App name 'MaddenTool' in the title bar with minimise, maximise and close buttons. Dark theme: near-black graphite background #121417, panels #1A1D21, hairline dividers #2A2F36, off-white text, one restrained amber accent for the primary button and keyboard focus ring, muted teal and muted red only for small status text. Layout, left to right: (1) a 48px icon-only navigation rail; (2) the dominant central area, a very dense data table with about 34 visible rows of 22px height, zebra-free, tabular numerals, sticky header; (3) a docked right inspector panel about 400px wide. Above the table, one compact toolbar: search field 'Search 1964 class', dropdown filters 'Position', 'League: AFL + NFL', 'Evidence', a 'Columns' button, a small switch labelled 'Spoilers', a secondary button 'Generate' and an amber primary button 'Validate & export'. A title-bar subtitle reads '1964 class' followed by small neutral chips 'Lens: Career (example)', 'Hindsight 1.00', 'Seed 7F3A-21C9', 'Offline'. Table columns in order: '#', 'Selections', 'Player', 'Pos', 'College', 'OVR', 'Dev', 'wAV', 'Evidence', 'Portrait', 'Flags'. Use placeholder row text exactly like 'Prospect 01', 'Prospect 02' and so on for player names, and 'College' for colleges. The 'Dev' column shows a small 18px badge slot followed by a short word. One row is selected with a 2px amber outline. Right inspector, top to bottom: a neutral grey silhouette placeholder portrait, name heading, a 'Selections' list with two lines, a 'Career facts' block, a 'Why this rating' block made of label-value rows only (Lens, Hindsight, wAV, Evidence, Group percentile, Estimated), and a 'Provenance' block with small grey source text. A thin status bar at the bottom spanning the full width with three separate segments: 'Active', 'Export limit 402', 'File capacity 455', plus 'Overflow' and 'Validation: 0 errors, 3 warnings'. Crisp Inter-like typography, 12-13px text, aligned columns, calm professional scouting-desk mood. No logos, no team marks, no photographs of people, no stadiums, no gradients, no glow, no charts, no big metric cards.
